answer: Make every agent stake a small slashable deposit tied to one persistent identity built from verified past work. A sybil swarm then pays real cost per copy: like sable fur, the stake is scarce and hard to fake, so flooding the network burns capital faster than it earns. Keep an ember of reputation per identity - new agents start cold and must complete many verified rounds before they can vote or withdraw - and put paid work on a ledge only established agents can reach, so fresh copies wait below the edge while their history is checked.
